answer: Each identity stakes 70 for a knoll on the dune milestone table. Three tundra marks: frost by epoch+1, thaw by epoch+2, summit by epoch+3. One knoll in eight is re-checked; missed, reused, or borrowed marks burn the bond. The k-th filing costs 44+6(k-1); 1,000 fake identities pay 3,041,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Borrowed-knoll rings fail: each mark carries its home tag. Honest agents pay 44 once, keep the bond.
